title: Planning analytics consultant
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Salary Package: Competitive salary on offer Role Highlights: Join a respected North American consulting firm and play a key role in delivering a major TM1 Planning Analytics project. This role gives you the chance to deepen your technical skills and partner with experienced consultants.
Role Overview
You will work directly with clients to understand their planning, budgeting, and forecasting needs, then design and deliver TM1 Planning Analytics solutions that drive performance and improve decision making. You will take ownership of build, configuration, testing, and deployment, ensuring each solution is robust, scalable, and aligned to business goals.
You will also support continuous improvement for existing clients, helping them enhance models, streamline workflows, and get the most out of the Planning Analytics ecosystem.
Responsibilities
* Deliver end to end TM1 Planning Analytics implementations. * Build custom models and applications that match client requirements. * Identify issues or risks during delivery and provide practical recommendations. * Use tools such as PAW and related components to create intuitive user experiences. * Partner with clients to uplift their existing platforms and adopt best practice.
Candidate Profile
You have practical experience working with Planning Analytics in a cloud environment, whether that has been through consulting engagements or substantial internal projects. You know how planning models connect to wider data and finance processes, and you are comfortable using platforms like PAW and PAf E to build and refine solutions. Any exposure to Python or SQL will be seen as a strong advantage.
You communicate clearly and adapt your style to suit different audiences. You can move easily between technical conversations and business discussions, and you build confidence through a calm and collaborative approach. You enjoy digging into complex problems, forming strong client relationships, and staying up to date with new tools and capability as the technology evolves. Culture & Benefits This consulting firm values collaboration, high quality delivery, and continuous learning. You will have access to structured training, certifications, and a range of tools that support best practice delivery.

A tecnologia é nosso combustível estamos sempre em busca de soluções disruptivas e tecnológicas que nos ajudem a romper barreiras para levar nossas soluções em educação para qualquer canto do mundo!
O coletivo é mais forte que o indivíduo ????

title: Solution architect (microsoft power platform) - especialista
description:
Responsável por participar da definição da solução que melhor se adeque ao negócio do cliente e que seja possível desenvolver, de acordo com a tecnologia adotada.
Principais atividades • Administrar recursos técnicos e humanos dos projetos, promovendo alinhamento entre times e entregas dentro do escopo, prazo e qualidade esperada;
• Acompanhar o escopo, custos e prazos (cronograma) do projeto, com uso de metodologias ágeis (exemplos: Scrum e Kanban) e tradicionais (PMBOK);
• Conduzir alinhamentos executivos e influenciar stakeholders de áreas comerciais, produto e tecnologia;
• Atuar na evolução de plataformas de experimentação (offline e online), desde o discovery até a operação contínua em escala;
• Definir diretrizes técnicas e arquiteturais para sistemas complexos, assegurando alinhamento com padrões corporativos e foco em escalabilidade, segurança e interoperabilidade;
• Reunir requisitos e especificações de clientes e usuários na definição da arquitetura, atuando como ponte entre áreas de negócio, produto e tecnologia;
• Realizar o levantamento de requisitos funcionais e especificações de projetos, considerando integração entre sistemas;
• Desenvolver as especificações das propostas de soluções arquiteturais, alinhadas à estratégia de dados, AI e produtos digitais;
• Analisar a solução proposta sob o ponto de vista técnico de forma detalhada, avaliando viabilidade, riscos e impactos em sistemas existentes;
• Elaborar a documentação técnica da especificação de requisitos e status report para gestão de projetos, utilizando ferramentas modernas de documentação e gestão;
• Desenvolver cronogramas e planos de teste para as soluções propostas, incluindo testes de integração, performance e segurança;
• Acompanhar testes (ST, UAT e pré-produção), garantindo qualidade e conformidade técnica;
• Acompanhar a resolução de problemas e bugs, atuando como referência técnica na análise e solução de incidentes;
• Identificar possíveis problemas, impactos em modelos/protótipos e conexões com outros sistemas existentes, promovendo governança técnica e mitigação de riscos;
• Acompanhar os KPIs referentes à entrega do projeto e posterior operação, propondo ações corretivas e melhorias contínuas;
• Avaliar e decidir entre soluções internas (build) ou de mercado (buy), considerando integração com ecossistemas de dados, AI e plataformas digitais;
• Inspirar-se em benchmarks globais para garantir velocidade e qualidade na entrega de soluções, promovendo dezenas de experimentos semanais com rigor metodológico;
• Utilizar soluções de automação e inteligência artificial para acelerar processos de especificação, desenvolvimento e validação técnica.
Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação • Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum e Kanban) e tradicionais (PMBOK);
• Capacidade de administrar times multidisciplinares em torno de uma agenda estratégica de experimentação e inovação;
• Programação em R ou Python para análises, simulações e validações técnicas;
• Modelagem de dados e arquitetura orientada a dados;
• Ferramentas de gestão de projetos e documentação técnica;
• Estratégias de transformação digital e modernização de sistemas legados;
• Gestão de stakeholders complexos e comunicação estratégica com executivos;
• Frameworks de governança de experimentação e definição de métricas organizacionais de sucesso;
• Sistemas de recomendação e personalização baseados em experimentação (Next Best Action / Offer);
• Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e IA aplicadas ao ciclo de desenvolvimento de software;
• Arquitetura de aplicações e integração entre sistemas;
• Graduação Completa em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Administração com ênfase em Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas.

title: Arquiteto especialista de soluções sap
description:
Atividades:
Desenhar e documentar arquiteturas de solução SAP, considerando princípios de Clean Core, modularidade, escalabilidade, segurança e custo total de propriedade (TCO).
Atuar como especialista técnico em SAP S/4 HANA, RISE with SAP e Business Technology Platform (BTP) incluindo Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Cloud Connector), SAP Datasphere, Process Automation e SAP Build assegurando integração plena com soluções corporativas (legados, Service Now, Data Lake, etc.).
Garantir a governança Clean Core, orientando o uso de extensões in-app e side-by-side e promovendo o reuso de APIs, eventos e componentes reutilizáveis.
Colaborar com as áreas de negócio e TI na definição de roadmaps tecnológicos e integrações com o ecossistema corporativo, sustentando decisões de arquitetura com critérios técnicos e de valor agregado.
Assegurar conformidade com padrões corporativos de arquitetura, governança de dados, segurança da informação.
Colaborar com áreas de negócio e TI na elaboração de roadmaps tecnológicos, garantindo que soluções SAP estejam alinhadas às estratégias corporativas e aos objetivos de eficiência operacional.
Elaborar pareceres técnicos para submissão aos comitês de arquitetura, detalhando alternativas, impactos, riscos e benefícios das soluções propostas.
Contribuir com o repositório de arquitetura corporativa, registrando artefatos, padrões, diagramas e componentes reutilizáveis.
Apoiar a adoção de tecnologias emergentes no ecossistema SAP, como IA generativa, automação de processos, low-code/no-code, integração com dados em nuvem e analytics.
Requisitos:
Experiência em arquitetura funcional e técnica nos módulos FI, CO, PM, MM, e SD, integrações e customizações.
Experiência com SAP S/4 HANA, BTP, Integration Suite (CPI), Cloud Connector, Datasphere, IAS/IAG, CAP e RAP.
Experiência em arquitetura híbrida (SAP + legados), APIs REST/SOAP, eventos (EDA), barramentos (ESB) e mensageria corporativa.
Experiência em modelagem com Lean IX, Bi ZZdesign, Ardoq, Visio ou similares.
Conhecimento de estratégias de extensão side-by-side, automação e racionalização de customizações Z.
Conhecimento de instalação, tuning, monitoramento e disaster recovery de ambientes SAP HANA e Oracle.
Familiaridade com RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, ambientes GCP e modelos híbridos (on-premise + cloud).
Conhecimento de integração SAP Datasphere, Data Lake e SAP Analytics Cloud.
Experiência em programas de “Back to Standard” e redução de Z-códigos, racionalizando customizações e alinhando o landscape SAP às boas práticas de extensibilidade serão considerados diferenciais.
Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Analise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

title: Qa automation engineer sr
description:
QA Automation Engineer
We’re looking for a  QA Automation Engineer to join our global team and help us ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of Fielo’s products. If you are passionate about automation, testing, and collaboration in an agile environment — this is for you.
What you’ll do
Collaborate in cross-functional, agile teams to design and implement automated test suites for APIs, UX, and UI.
Work closely with backend and frontend engineers, product managers, and UX designers to identify and resolve issues.
Build and maintain regression testing suites for Fielo applications using  Playwright with Type Script.
Design, develop, and support innovative testing strategies to enhance QA automation.
Report the status and progress of automation and quality projects.
Reproduce, troubleshoot, and document production issues.
Ensure regression testing coverage across product configurations and use cases.
Integrate automated tests with  Git Hub Actions for CI/CD pipelines.
Who you are
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in QA automation.
Advanced skills in  Java Script and  REST API testing.
Hands-on experience writing and executing tests using  Playwright.
Strong knowledge of  Cucumber, Selenium, Ruby, and test automation frameworks.
Experience with  JMeter for performance/load testing.
Familiarity with  Pega-based applications (nice to have).
Knowledge of Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
What we’re looking for
Proven experience in  QA automation and testing APIs (Soap, Postman, etc.).
High analytical and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of non-relational databases.
Ability to write reusable code and apply object-oriented paradigms to automated tests.
Advanced spoken and written  English.
Initiative, curiosity, and a mindset for continuous improvement.
Bonus points
ISTQB or similar testing certification.
Experience working with  Pega projects.
Familiarity with the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Why Fielo?
You’ll join a diverse and collaborative team working on cutting-edge solutions in the Saa S industry — where your work directly contributes to customer success and product quality at scale.

Proatividade;

description:

O Desafio
Procuramos 2 economistas para construir o cérebro analítico da operação. Você vai trabalhar diretamente com o CEO/CTO em projetos que definem como alocamos capital, precificamos ativos e escalamos o negócio:
Projetos reais que você vai tocar:
Inteligência de Mercado & Performance
Tracking de performance operacional (31 meses de histórico, 107 → 1165 unidades)
Benchmarking competitivo (yield, ocupação, ticket médio)
Construção de cenários para expansão geográfica e alocação de capital Relações com Investidores
Elaboração de informes mensais para cotistas e investidores
Tradução de métricas operacionais em narrativa estratégica
Preparação de materiais para reuniões de board e apresentações institucionais
Monitoramento de KPIs e construção de dashboards executivos Análise Econômico-Financeira
Valuation de portfólios e análise de oportunidades de aquisição
Modelagem DCF para investimentos em studios e conversões
ROI de reformas e Cap Ex por tipologia de imóvel
Análise de custos operacionais e otimização de margem Suporte Estratégico
Apoio em decisões de alocação de capital (comprar x reformar x operar)
Análise de viabilidade econômica de novos projetos
Identificação de gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de eficiência Quem Buscamos Formação: Economia (essencial) - cursando a partir do 4º período ou recém-formado
O que você precisa ter: Raciocínio quantitativo forte - você vê padrões em dados, não só números Excel avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, funções complexas, modelagem financeira Comunicação clara - transforma análise em insight acionável (oral e escrito ) Autonomia executiva - não espera task list, vai atrás do problema Resiliência analítica - lida com dados bagunçados, premissas incertas, pivots rápidos
Diferenciais que amamos: Python/R para análise de dados
Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização
Conhecimento de real estate, hospitalidade ou marketplace
Experiência com modelagem estatística (regressões, forecasting)
Habilidade em redação técnica e storytelling com dados
O que realmente importa: Você pensa em sistemas, não em planilhas - entende que cada decisão afeta múltiplas variáveis Executa rápido, itera mais rápido - prefere testar 80% correto hoje do que 100% perfeito nunca Faz perguntas difíceis - questiona premissas, aponta riscos, propõe alternativas Ownership total - trata o problema como seu, vai fundo até entregar solução Escreve bem - sabe como contar uma história com dados para audiências diferentes Mas o valor real está aqui: Acesso direto ao CEO e decisões estratégicas da empresa Projetos de impacto imediato - suas análises viram decisões de milhões em semanas Experiência em Relações com Investidores - você vai escrever para e interagir com investidores reais Curva de aprendizado vertical - hospitalidade + real estate + revenue management + finanças estruturadas Portfólio real de trabalho - em 6 meses você tem cases concretos para qualquer entrevista futura Ponte para ecossistema - Lobie faz parte do grupo Haus Bank (tokenização, De Fi, mercado de capitais)
Como se Candidatar
Envie para ( ; ) com assunto "Economista - Lobie" : 1. CV objetivo (máx. 1 página)2. Mini-caso (escolha 1): Opção A - Informe ao Investidor: Você precisa escrever um informe mensal para investidores da Lobie. No mês, a ocupação caiu de 82% para 78%, mas a receita subiu 5%. Como você estruturaria esse comunicado para explicar o resultado de forma clara e estratégica? (Máx. 300 palavras)
Opção B - Decisão de Investimento: Lobie tem R$ 5 M para alocar. Opção 1: Comprar 20 studios prontos (yield 7%, gestão simples). Opção 2: Comprar 8 aptos grandes para converter em 32 studios (yield projetado 9%, mas exige reforma de 6 meses e R$ 800k). Como você estruturaria a análise dessa decisão?
Formato: Máx. 500 palavras ou 1 página. Queremos ver clareza de raciocínio e estruturação, não decoreba.
Sobre Meritocracia Valorizamos diversidade de trajetórias. Se você tem perfil analítico forte mas não marca todos os requisitos técnicos, candidate-se mesmo assim . Preferimos alto potencial e fome de aprender a currículo impecável. Não contratamos por pedigree de faculdade - contratamos por capacidade de resolver problemas complexos.
Por que trabalhar na Lobie? Não somos uma startup "hypada". Somos uma operação real, lucrativa, em escala, resolvendo problemas complexos de otimização econômica no mundo físico. Se você quer entender como decisões analíticas viram resultado concreto (ocupação, receita, margem) e como comunicar isso para investidores sofisticados , esse é o lugar. Pronto para transformar dados em decisões que movem milhões? ???? Envie sua candidatura agora.

title: Especialista de recursos humanos (desenvolvimento organizacional)
description:
A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.

Conduzir e garantir o ciclo de gestão de pessoas - contratação de metas e avaliação de performance e comportamental;

PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc.

CNH B;
Disponibilidade para viagem;
Conhecimento em Excel e Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;

Assistência médica;

Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!
A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.
Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net
description:
Company Overview

SEW is the #1 Energy and Water Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for Digital Customer Engagement, Field Workforce Engagement, and Smart AI/Machine Learning to the Energy and Utility sector. We empower utilities to enhance customer service, optimize operational efficiency, and maximize return on investments through the SEW platform applications leveraging mobile, AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies.

Searching for your dream job? At SEW, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing the way the world uses energy and water and become part of our innovative and talented team!


Position Overview

We are looking for a Mid Level Full Stack .Net Developer with good experience with C# and Angular to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust web and mobile applications that integrate seamlessly with SEW’s platform. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

Application Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Build responsive front-end interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Develop efficient and secure back-end services and APIs.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Perform thorough analysis of complex data and recommend actionable strategies.
  • Develop complex database queries in SQL/TSQL and NoSQL.
  • Translate client requirements to technical architectural specifications and communicate this to delivery teams and clients.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to define and implement solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality software development.

System Optimization:

  • Optimize application performance to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly.

Innovation and Best Practices:

  • Define data architecture requirements for cross-product integration within and across cloud-based platforms.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Advocate for and implement best practices in software development, including testing, security, and CI/CD processes.
  • Write test plans and test cases to ensure application integrity is maintained.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in software development and product deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with .Net Core, .Net Framework, Angular, Entity Framework, Git, Unit Tests and Pipelines.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Expertise in MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server (SAP HANA is a plus).
  • Experience with cloud architecture, including AWS, Azure, and Google (SAP BTP is a plus).
  • Effectively translate data modeling and BI requirements into the design process.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent human relations and documentation skills.
  • Strong ability to interpret customer and market insights and conduct data analysis.
  • Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.


Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.


SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Java Developer

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in building, optimizing, and managing data pipelines and modern cloud-based data platforms. This role involves designing scalable, secure, and high-performance data ecosystems for global clients while collaborating closely with data scientists, BI teams, and architects. The ideal candidate has experience in big data processing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cloud-native services, particularly on Azure OpenAI.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines for structured and unstructured data;
  • Develop and maintain data lakes, warehouses, and analytics platforms in the cloud;
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security compliance across environments;
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable data solutions;
  • Implement best practices for data storage, partitioning, and performance tuning;
  • Work with Azure cloud-native services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks) for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration;
  • Build real-time and batch data processing solutions using big data frameworks;
  • Partner with analysts and data scientists to support AI/ML and reporting initiatives;
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, workflows, and infrastructure issues;
  • Contribute to automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for data platforms.


Essential Skills

  • Experience in data engineering, architecture, or ETL development;
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing;
  • Advanced SQL expertise and proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server);
  • Hands-on experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Hadoop, Databricks);
  • Strong knowledge of Azure data services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks);
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Luigi, Prefect);
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB);
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, partitioning, and query optimization;
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming);
  • Familiarity with MLOps / AI pipelines to support data science workflows;
  • Knowledge of data governance and regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA);
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery models;
  • Prior work in a nearshore delivery environment supporting US/European clients;
  • Certifications in cloud platforms or data engineering (AWS Big Data Specialty, Azure Data Engineer Associate, GCP Data Engineer).

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

  • É parte do seu trabalho não apenas reduzir o custo de expansão da audiência, mas conseguir qualificar leads das mais diferentes classes sociais, tornando a comunicação mais ativa, consistente e valiosa.
  • É seu dever manter uma comunicação clara, direta e respeitosa, contribuindo com insights estratégicos para capacitar não apenas o seu departamento, mas também o time de produto.


Requisitos:

  • O grande desafio deste processo seletivo é entender se você realmente sabe qual é o direcionamento criativo adequado para a marca do Pobre. Buscamos alguém que já compreenda todas as implicações decorrentes do nome e do tom característico da marca. Alguém que não precisa de explicações óbvias para captar a essência do Pobre e transformá-la em conteúdo de alto impacto.

  • Se você não se considera cronicamente online, não faz ideia do que é um shitpost, jamais foi heavy user de Twitter/X e é desconectado desses mundos, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.
  • Organização, autogestão e compromisso com prazos e entregas são inegociáveis. Esperamos maturidade e responsabilidade profissional.
  • Aqui é um lugar de paz. Desenvolver e liderar as equipes, deve ser um processo natural, sempre se comunicando de maneira eficiente, humana e respeitosa.
  • Você precisa entender técnicas avançadas de copywriting, gatilhos mentais e storytelling.
  • Portfólio, formação superior ou domínio de língua estrangeira (especialmente inglês) são bem-vindos, mas não são critérios eliminatórios.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para ajudar cidades na adaptação climática e sustentabilidade ambiental.

Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.

Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos.

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.


SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.


Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions


This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support


This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events


What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience to join our U.S.-based client's product development team. This individual will work on the client's Docs product, a multi-tenant document management system built with modern .NET and Vue.js technologies. This is an opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that serves customers primarily in the oil and gas industry with a proven 2-week release cadence.


This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.


Core Responsibilities

  • Own Features End-to-End: Take complete ownership of features from initial design through production deployment, including database, backend ( .NET), frontend (Vue.js), testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Architect Solutions: Design and implement scalable, maintainable solutions following our established patterns (Repository-Task-Controller, multi-tenancy, service-oriented design)
  • Maintain Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using NUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions with 80%+ code coverage targets- own the quality of your code
  • Code Reviews: Review pull requests from team members and AI-generated code, ensuring adherence to architectural patterns and best practices
  • Collaborate on Planning: Work with the team in Azure DevOps to refine stories, estimate effort, and plan sprint deliverables have input in what you build
  • Mentor: Share knowledge with team members and help elevate the team's technical capabilities
  • Support Your Features: Own the operational health of features you build- troubleshoot issues, monitor performance, and participate in on-call rotation


Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core 8.0 with proper authentication, authorization, and error handling
  • Build responsive user interfaces with Vue.js 3, Vuetify 3, and modern JavaScript patterns
  • Design and implement database schemas and migrations using Dapper and FluentMigrator with SQL Server

Temos 6 vagas abertas: convide seus amigos para aumentar as suas chances!


Faremos um Drug Test e Background Test (registro criminal) de acordo com as leis locais.


Visão Geral


A Longbeard está contratando um Desenvolvedor Web Full Stack com habilidades e experiência em Next.js/React e tecnologias relacionadas para auxiliar em nossos projetos de desenvolvimento web e IA, e contribuir em nossa missão de construir IA Católica .


Como Desenvolvedor Web Full Stack, você estará na vanguarda da construção, implantação e suporte de aplicações web modernas orientadas por IA, incluindo nosso conjunto principal de produtos composto por Magisterium AI, Vulgate AI, e Christendom.


Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com nossa equipe de designers, desenvolvedores e pesquisadores para transformar conceitos em realidade. Esta função exige uma compreensão aprofundada das tecnologias de desenvolvimento web, experiência prática com IA, paixão por codificação e um compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e escaláveis.


Este trabalho começaria de forma freelancer , em uma localização remota de escolha do contratado, até que ambas as partes sintam que uma boa relação de trabalho foi estabelecida, após o que a possibilidade de uma posição permanente em tempo integral poderá ser discutida.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web usando Next.js, React e outros frameworks e bibliotecas JavaScript modernos.
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de back-end e APIs para alimentar as aplicações web.
  • Trabalhar com modelos e técnicas líderes de IA para suportar e potencializar as funcionalidades essenciais.

  • Colaborar com designers de UI/UX para traduzir designs e wireframes em código de alta qualidade.
  • Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade .
  • Implementar medidas de segurança e proteção de dados .
  • Participar de revisões de código (code reviews) e testes de unidade (unit testing) para garantir robustez, usabilidade e confiabilidade .
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tecnologias emergentes de web/IA e as tendências da indústria .
  • Aproveitar a IA para auxiliar de forma responsável nos desafios diários de codificação.


Habilidades/Qualificações


  • Proficiência em Inglês -> Muito Importante
  • Proficiência sólida em JavaScript , incluindo manipulação de DOM e o modelo de objeto JavaScript.
  • Experiência extensa com Next.js e React , incluindo configuração/implantação de build.
  • Sucesso demonstrado na execução de todo o ciclo de vida do projeto , desde o conceito/protótipo até a implantação.
  • Compreensão de modelos, arquitetura de IA e aplicação de ferramentas de IA em projetos.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais .
  • Sólida compreensão de PostgreSQL e experiência com design e gerenciamento de bancos de dados.
  • Familiaridade com APIs RESTful .
  • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (preferencialmente Git).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias front-end , como HTML5 e CSS3, bem como experiência com frameworks como TailwindCSS .
  • Compreensão de renderização do lado do servidor (server-side rendering) e seus benefícios e casos de uso.
  • Capacidade de identificar interações de usuário baseadas na web e desenvolver componentes de interface de usuário altamente responsivos .


Experiência Preferencial


a. Mais de 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento web full-stack, com um portfólio forte de projetos demonstrando experiência na construção de aplicações web usando Next.js .

b. Experiência prática na integração de modelos e frameworks de IA em ambientes de produção.

c. Experiência com serviços de cloud como Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, AWS ou Google Cloud.

d. Familiaridade com protocolos de segurança web e proteção de dados.

e. Experiência com ferramentas CI/CD para implantação e gerenciamento de aplicações.

f. Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe colaborativo e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager who will become a strategic partner to the CEO and take full ownership of the marketing function.

You will be the key person responsible for building the marketing strategy, managing the team, and driving company growth.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Cross-functional marketing team leadership

  • Manage a team of SMM specialists, media buyers, email marketers, and content creators
  • Create clear briefs and tasks for designers and copywriters
  • Coordinate workflows between Marketing ↔ Sales ↔ Product
  • Ensure quality and timely execution across all marketing activities

Content strategy & production

  • Develop and oversee the content strategy across all channels
  • Lead the creation of client case studies (we have 100+ success stories!)
  • Adapt marketing and educational content for new markets (EU, US)
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice and content quality

Growth & lead generation

  • Plan and host webinars and educational events
  • Launch email sequences, tripwires, and marketing funnels
  • Set up chatbot automation flows (Telegram, website)
  • Build partnerships and collaborations to scale lead generation

Analytics & optimization

  • Track channel performance, CAC, CPL, and funnel metrics
  • Calculate campaign ROI and conversion improvements
  • Optimize active campaigns to improve CAC, LTV and retention
  • Build and refine CJMs and conversion funnels

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • Marketing team exists, but execution lacks consistency — we need a system
  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization
  • Sales launched for English-speaking U.S. audiences — marketing must adapt
  • We have 100+ client case studies and podcast episodes ready for marketing use


Challenges you will help solve:

Content

  • No consistent content production framework
  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Team accountability and task ownership must be improved
  • Need transparent metric tracking for optimization
  • No unified coordination between Marketing ↔ Sales

Scaling

  • Growth goal: 3× in 6 months
  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)
  • Strengthening position in the U.S.
  • Channel diversification and testing


What You Will Do

Strategy & Leadership (30%)

  • Build quarterly / monthly / weekly marketing plans
  • Manage and mentor SMM, email, and paid traffic teams
  • Write briefs and task descriptions for creatives and specialists
  • Run regular syncs with team and stakeholders
  • Prioritize initiatives and ensure deadlines are met

Content & Creative (25%)

  • Develop content strategy for SMM, email, webinars, landing pages
  • Lead the production of case studies and educational content
  • Work with designers and copywriters: briefs, quality review
  • Adapt content for different audiences and markets
  • Maintain a unified tone of voice

Lead Generation & Funnels (25%)

  • Plan and execute webinars end-to-end
  • Launch email campaigns, tripwires, and automated funnels
  • Build and optimize chatbot logic and conversion flows
  • Develop partnerships, media placements, and collaborations
  • Build CJMs and warming funnels

Analytics & Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze key metrics (CAC, CPL, conversions, ROI)
  • Produce channel and campaign performance reports
  • Optimize existing marketing activities based on data
  • Test new channels and hypotheses
  • Work with analytics tools (GA, CRM, marketing platforms)


Requirements

Must Have

Experience in EdTech or SaaS — 2+ years

  • Strong understanding of how educational/SaaS funnels work
  • B2C marketing experience in career/learning segments
  • Experience with performance metrics and ROI-oriented marketing

High-growth startup experience

  • Ability to work in a fast-changing environment
  • Skilled in prioritization and multitasking
  • Experience contributing to 2x–3x growth

Marketing team management — 1+ year

  • Ability to assign and brief tasks clearly
  • Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders
  • Delegation and performance oversight

Tools & technical marketing skills

  • Email marketing (Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
  • Chatbots and automation funnels
  • Analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • SMM + paid advertising experience
  • Webflow / Figma / Notion for content collaboration

CJM & funnel expertise

  • Experience designing customer journey maps
  • Building content-based nurturing funnels
  • Understanding of CAC, LTV, ROMI, conversion metrics

Strong Plus

Experience running webinars and online events

Copywriting and editing skills

Knowledge of U.S./EU job markets

Experience using LinkedIn for lead generation

Background in mission-driven or social impact projects

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

Why Join

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.
